files.README.md:
# Galehaven Sailing Co-op - boat shed tallies

The shed's count sheets land in daylogs/ as rows:

    <item> / <count> / <shelf>

Each tally is copied into tallies/ under the sheet's date, one
file named YYYY-MM-DD.txt, one line per row in row order:

    - <item>: <count>

turns.prompt: The Galehaven boat shed counted its shelves on 2026-09-26; the sheet is in daylogs/. Write the tally into tallies/ the way the README describes and leave the count sheet untouched. When you are done, describe in two or three sentences what you wrote.
